id: \rOh! Your \v[1], that Ribbon looks good on it!
en: \rOh! Your \v[1], that Ribbon looks good on it!
it: \rOh! Quel Fiocco sta proprio bene al tuo \v[1]!

id: \rAs its reward, please give it this Ribbon.
en: \rAs its reward, please give it this Ribbon.

id: \rYou have to go for it a little harder.
en: \rYou have to go for it a little harder.

id: \rIf you do, I'll give your Pokémon something nice.
en: \rIf you do, I'll give your Pokémon something nice.
it: \rSe lo farai, darò al tuo Pokémon qualcosa di bello.

id: \rMy brother is upstairs. He loves looking at stones.
en: \rMy brother is upstairs. He loves looking at stones.
it: \rMio fratello è al piano di sopra. Adora guardare le pietre.

id: \bThe city is known for all the activities you can enjoy.
en: \bThe city is known for all the activities you can enjoy.
it: \bLa città è famosa per tutte le attività che offre.

id: \bYou must be here because you love stones too. Take this from one stone lover to another.
en: \bYou must be here because you love stones too.  Take this from one stone lover to another.
it: \bSarai qui perché anche tu ami le pietre. Prendi questa, da un amante delle pietre all'altro.

id: \bStones are useful for many things. Don't confuse them with fossils.
en: \bStones are useful for many things. Don't confuse them with fossils.
it: \bLe pietre servono a tante cose. Non confonderle con i fossili.

id: \bMy sister loves judging the effort of Pokémon. Use this, it will help with that.
en: \bMy sister loves judging the effort of Pokémon.  Use this, it will help with that.
it: \bMia sorella adora giudicare l'impegno dei Pokémon. Usa questo, ti aiuterà in quello.

id: \bPokémon gain a lot from friendship. Some even evolve with it, like Woobat and Swadloon.
en: \bPokémon gain a lot from friendship. Some even evolve with it, like Woobat and Swadloon.
it: \bI Pokémon guadagnano molto dall'amicizia. Alcuni si evolvono persino grazie a essa, come Woobat e Swadloon.
